R-AD-PORT-PRESSURE.basis: transducer range 35-1500 mbar [DIRECT, Kala (ADE) JOAST 67(2A) 2015 p. 215]
R-AD-PORT-PRESSURE.source: parameter_inventory.csv AD.DPA/AD.DPB; tejas_airframe_aero_fcs.md (Kala 2015 transducer quote); report §4 air data
R-AD-PORT-PRESSURE.statement: The inventory names AD.DPA/DPB 'differential pressure' but gives 35-1500 mbar, the range Kala (2015) quotes for the ADC transducers on the flow-angle ports (P-alpha1/beta1, P-alpha2/beta2; 'four pressure transducers fitted inside each ADC ... 35 to 1300 mbar (Ps); 35-2700 mbar (Pt), 35-1500 mbar (P-alpha/beta)'). A range starting at 35 mbar, like the absolute Ps/Pt transducers, is an absolute range, so the channels are absolute port pressures from which the ADC computes AoA/AoSS by differencing; the range is kept as written (DIRECT) and the pressure reference is absolute.
R-AD-PORT-PRESSURE.sweep: pressure reference absolute (35-1500 mbar) or differential (signed, +/-1465 mbar span)
R-AD-PORT-PRESSURE.title: AD.DPA/DPB are flow-angle port pressures (absolute), not differential pressures

R-AD51-COMPUTED.basis: AD-51 (architecture decision register); the radar-altimeter tracker model in phalanx.sensors.avionics.radalt
R-AD51-COMPUTED.statement: The inventory classes NAV.RADALT as measured. The radar altimeter's height word is the output of the LRU's own range tracker (internally digitised, acquisition LRU-INT), and AD-51 makes it an output of the M12 avionics extension supplied to the recorder as a RECORDED (LRU-computed) value, like the INS and AHRS outputs. The channel's signal class is therefore computed (no recorder-side converter, no adc_bits); range, LSB, bus and sinks are unchanged.
R-AD51-COMPUTED.title: The radar-altimeter height is an LRU-computed digital output (AD-51), not an analog reading

R-ADC-BITS.source: parameter_inventory.csv FTI.ALL ('10-12 bit PCM typical'); architecture M01 (ADC bits per channel)
R-ADC-BITS.statement: For analog-acquired channels, adc_bits = max(12, ceil(log2(span / native_step))).
R-ADC-BITS.title: ADC resolution sufficient for the native step

R-CAL-LINEAR.source: IRIG 106 Ch9 C-group polynomial conversion (data_pathway_and_formats.md Q4/Q6)
R-CAL-LINEAR.statement: EU = c0 + c1 x counts with c0 = 0 and c1 = recorder LSB for BNR words; the calibration date is the dictionary release date. Per-serial calibration and installation bias are hidden state of M12 (AD-07), not dictionary values.
R-CAL-LINEAR.sweep: none at dictionary level (per-serial offsets are M12 latent states)
R-CAL-LINEAR.title: Linear counts-to-EU calibration at dictionary level

R-CODE-WORD.source: src/phalanx/bus/words.py (W1.7, A-W1.7-6); R-CODES-SYNTHETIC defines the format, not the bit layout
R-CODE-WORD.statement: A code_word channel carries one synthetic SSS-NNN code per 16-bit word: prefix index k (position of the prefix in the channel's prefixes list) in bits 15-10 and NNN in bits 9-0; the EU value (CIR and contract) is k * 1000 + NNN, and 0 means no active code. Moved into the dictionary (bit_code_format.word_layout) from the W1.7 bus encoder (A-W1.7-6).
R-CODE-WORD.title: Code-word bit layout of SSS-NNN fault-code channels

R-CODES-PHASE.statement: SYS.PHASE uses the DASHlink PH codes (0 unknown, 1 preflight, 2 taxi, 3 takeoff, 4 climb, 5 cruise, 6 approach, 7 rollout).
R-CODES-PHASE.title: Flight-phase codes from DASHlink

R-CODES-SYNTHETIC.replacement: CWS legend list and BIT code structure (architecture §19 request)
R-CODES-SYNTHETIC.source: architecture AD-19; tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q3/Q6; parameter_inventory.csv notes ('Tejas code structure not public', 'Legend list not public')
R-CODES-SYNTHETIC.statement: SSS-NNN BIT/fault codes, CWS legend slots, FCS law, GPS fix / figure of merit / INS mode, borescope grade and store-station codes are synthetic Phalanx tables (AD-19); real Tejas code structures, the CWS legend list and the IAF forms are not public. The GPS figure of merit is a 9-level code (the inventory gives its units as 'enum' and its quantisation as 'bits'); the number of levels and their order are synthetic. 0.1.2: FCS law 3 = GROUND (W1.2), fighter flight phases 8-15 (W1.1), and one unified BIT/fault/exceedance table `bit_codes` (104 codes: M14's 102 plus two M08 afterburner faults; severities, fault lists, CWS legend and voice mapping, monitor limit ids; AD-48 item 5) with a documented map from M08's earlier codes.
R-CODES-SYNTHETIC.title: Synthetic code tables

R-COMPONENTS.statement: Rows that combine several physical quantities (for example V/A/Ah) are split into one channel per quantity, as named in the row text, so that every channel has exactly one engineering unit.
R-COMPONENTS.title: Multi-quantity rows split into one channel per quantity

R-DISCRETE-PACK.source: parameter_inventory.csv recommended_quantization ('1 bit per discrete (bit-packed status word) [ASSUMPTION]'); MIL-STD-1553B §4.3.2 (data_pathway_and_formats.md Q2)
R-DISCRETE-PACK.statement: The discretes of a row are packed one bit each into a single 16-bit (or 32-bit) status word, bit order = order of mention in the row text; MIL-STD-1553B permits bit packing.
R-DISCRETE-PACK.sweep: bit order and word grouping (no effect on physical values)
R-DISCRETE-PACK.title: Discretes packed into bit-packed status words

R-FADEC-ADC.source: f404_in20_engine_model.md (Gaps: IN20 FADEC bit resolution not public; MSDC resolutions PS3 0.5 psia, N 16 rpm, T 1 K); empirical_dashlink_texture.md Q3; W1.3b report; src/phalanx/acquisition/config.py (sigma = sigma_steps x native_step)
R-FADEC-ADC.statement: FADEC lane channels (ENG.*.A/B, role lane, digitised inside the FADEC) carry the FADEC's own converter resolution in converter_step = full-scale span / 2^14 (analog lanes adc_bits = 14; speed lanes the equivalent 14-bit counter resolution). The IN20 FADEC bit resolution is not public (f404_in20_engine_model.md Gaps; empirical_dashlink_texture.md: 'F404-IN20 FADEC/1553 word resolution is unknown'); across the whole sweep the converter step stays finer than the recorded word LSB (PS3 0.5 psi, the -400 MSDC resolution), which is what the FADEC control loop needs (W1.3b: 0.5 psi PS3 steps make fuel flicker). Since 0.1.3 this step is the lanes' native_step (until 0.1.2 it was carried as converter_step while M13 still scaled its MEASURED lane noise by the native step; M13 now quantises the lanes at this step with the lane noise in EU, W2.2).
R-FADEC-ADC.title: FADEC lane converter step from an assumed 14-bit FADEC converter

R-ICD-429.source: data_pathway_and_formats.md Q2 (ARINC 429 word format; COTS LRUs on 429; Attachment 1 paywalled); DDP CWS (ARINC-429 + discretes)
R-ICD-429.statement: The CWS output and the radar altimeter use ARINC-429 links to the OAC. Labels are synthetic octal values, not ARINC 429 Attachment 1 assignments (paywalled); SDI 0; BNR data in bits 11-29 (19-bit two's complement); discrete words in bits 11-29; SSM per ARINC 429.
R-ICD-429.sweep: radar altimeter on 1553 instead of 429; label values arbitrary
R-ICD-429.title: CWS and radar altimeter on ARINC-429 with synthetic labels

R-ICD-DFCC.source: parameter_inventory.csv bus/bus_rate_hz ('50 (BC poll) of DFCC transmit buffer updated at 40 [ASSUMPTION]'); Raveendran & Prabhu RTO-MP-SCI-162-14 (DFCC -> 1553 -> CDR/GUH/FTI)
R-ICD-DFCC.statement: RT 1 (DFCC channel A interface) transmits the voted/selected FCS, actuator and relayed ADC words; channel B-D interfaces (RT 2-4) mirror it. The DFCC transmit buffer updates at FCS40 and the BC polls at AV50 (inventory [ASSUMPTION]); LG.WOW (inventory bus group FCS40) is carried here too.
R-ICD-DFCC.sweep: poll 40-80 Hz; mirrored vs channel-specific message sets
R-ICD-DFCC.title: DFCC 1553 interface carries voted FCS data and relayed air data

R-ICD-FADEC.source: parameter_inventory.csv ENG.* bus ('FADEC->1553 avionics bus or ARINC 429 ... [ASSUMPTION]'); tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q1 (Pickering note, F/A-18C SDC)
R-ICD-FADEC.statement: Engine and ECMS words are published by a FADEC/ECMS gateway RT on AV-MUX-2 (alternative: ARINC-429 to the OAC or a utility EU). FVG/CVG, which the inventory records on the CDR via an assumed FADEC->CDR path, use this RT.
R-ICD-FADEC.title: FADEC/ECMS gateway is a 1553 RT on AV-MUX-2

R-ICD-FTI-PCM.source: parameter_inventory.csv FTI.ALL ('10-12 bit PCM typical'); HAL trainer FTI 64 Hz (JOAST 67(2A) 331); HARV 25-800 sps
R-ICD-FTI-PCM.statement: FTI channels are 12-bit words of one synthetic PCM minor frame at 64 Hz (test aircraft only).
R-ICD-FTI-PCM.title: FTI channels in a synthetic PCM minor frame

R-ICD-OAC-BCAST.source: MIL-STD-1553B broadcast message structures (data_pathway_and_formats.md Q2); tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q1 (bus monitors)
R-ICD-OAC-BCAST.statement: Words that originate in the OAC (1553 bus status, UTC time word, pilot event marker) are sent as BC-to-RT broadcast messages (RT 31) on AV-MUX-2 so that the bus monitors record them.
R-ICD-OAC-BCAST.sweep: dedicated RT-to-RT messages instead of broadcast
R-ICD-OAC-BCAST.title: OAC-originated words are BC-to-broadcast messages

R-ICD-RS422.statement: ADC unit n sends to DFCC channel n over RS-422; these links are internal to the FCS and not recorded.
R-ICD-RS422.title: ADC to DFCC and FTP to DFCC over RS-422

R-ICD-RT-MAP.source: tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q1 Gaps (RT addresses not public)
R-ICD-RT-MAP.statement: RT addresses and the LRU-to-bus allocation are synthetic and arbitrary.
R-ICD-RT-MAP.sweep: any permutation (no physical effect; decoders must read addresses from the dictionary)
R-ICD-RT-MAP.title: Synthetic RT address map

R-ICD-TOPOLOGY.source: tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q1 Inferences; 'three 1553B buses' (FAS 1999, secondary only)
R-ICD-TOPOLOGY.statement: Three MIL-STD-1553B buses: AV-MUX-1 (mission; BC OAC), AV-MUX-2 (vehicle systems; BC OAC), WPN-MUX (BC SMS); CDR and HUMS DAU are listen-only bus monitors on AV-MUX-1/2. Labelled SYNTHETIC; not the Tejas ICD.
R-ICD-TOPOLOGY.sweep: 2-5 buses (Gripen has 5); FADEC on ARINC-429 instead of 1553
R-ICD-TOPOLOGY.title: Synthetic bus topology

R-ICD-UTILITY.source: parameter_inventory.csv origin_lru ('utility EU (production: BHEEM-EU / ECFM-C) [ASSUMPTION for allocation]'); tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q1
R-ICD-UTILITY.statement: Hydraulic, electrical, secondary-power, gear/brake/NWS/chute and fire signals are digitised and published by the BHEEM-EU RT; fuel, ECS and life-support signals by the ECFM-C RT. The digitising EU is the channel's clock domain.
R-ICD-UTILITY.sweep: alternative allocation between the two EUs
R-ICD-UTILITY.title: Utility signals are published by BHEEM-EU and ECFM-C

R-ICD-WORDS.source: data_pathway_and_formats.md Q2 Inferences (SAE AS15532 conventions; MIL-STD-1553B §4.3.2 MSW first) ; NAWCADPAX/RTR-2001/1 Table E-3 (F/A-18C validity words IAVAL3/IAVAL4, MSW/LSW) https://archive.org/details/DTIC_ADA407860
R-ICD-WORDS.statement: Analog quantities are 16-bit two's-complement BNR words with LSB = recorder LSB; quantities that do not fit use 2 words, most-significant word first; discretes are bit-packed; each message starts with one validity word per 16 data items (bit set = BUS_INVALID, AD-45), in the style of the F/A-18C ADC validity words; data items are packed in channel-ID order, fastest rate group first.
R-ICD-WORDS.sweep: word width 16/32 bits; validity carried in status bits instead of validity words
R-ICD-WORDS.title: AS15532-style data words and per-message validity words

R-INV-FIELD-ASSUMPTION.replacement: Tejas ICD / LRU specifications if released
R-INV-FIELD-ASSUMPTION.source: research_notes/Virtual fighter telemetry layer research/parameter_inventory.csv (field text)
R-INV-FIELD-ASSUMPTION.statement: Ranges, rates, sensor types, redundancy and allocations that the inventory itself marks [ASSUMPTION] in a field (for example ENG.OIL_P range 0-200 psid, AD.* bus rate 25 Hz, CDR 16 Hz) are used as written and tagged ASSUMPTION.
R-INV-FIELD-ASSUMPTION.sweep: ranges x0.5-x1.5 of span; rates inside the band stated in the field
R-INV-FIELD-ASSUMPTION.title: Inventory fields individually marked [ASSUMPTION]

R-INV-ROW-ASSUMPTION.replacement: GE/HAL FADEC I/O list and ADA utility I/O lists (architecture §19 requests)
R-INV-ROW-ASSUMPTION.source: research_notes/Virtual fighter telemetry layer research/parameter_inventory.csv (evidence_tag column)
R-INV-ROW-ASSUMPTION.statement: Values transcribed from inventory rows whose evidence tag contains ASSUMPTION (wholly or in part) are carried with that tag; the channel exists and is wired as the inventory states, but its existence, sensor or allocation on the IN20/Tejas is not public.
R-INV-ROW-ASSUMPTION.sweep: per value; channel existence on/off, ranges x0.5-x1.5 of span
R-INV-ROW-ASSUMPTION.title: Inventory rows whose evidence tag includes ASSUMPTION

R-JFS-RATED-SPEED.source: configs/tejas/params/M09.yaml jfs.jfs_rated_speed (A-W1.4-26: 100 kW-class centrifugal gas generators run ~50-70 krpm)
R-JFS-RATED-SPEED.statement: 100 % SPS.JFS.SPEED = 60,000 rpm, the M09 JFS model's rated gas-generator speed (A-W1.4-26); one value, tested equal to M09's jfs_rated_speed. Not public.
R-JFS-RATED-SPEED.title: JFS (GTSU-110) rated speed, the EU reference of SPS.JFS.SPEED

R-LANE-ACTUATOR-UNITS.source: parameter_inventory.csv FCS.SLAT.POS, FCS.AIRBRAKE.POS; report §1 (13 actuators: 4 elevons, rudder, 6 slats, 2 airbrakes)
R-LANE-ACTUATOR-UNITS.statement: FCS.SLAT.POS covers 6 slat actuators (IB/MB/OB per side), each with dual electrical position feedback; FCS.AIRBRAKE.POS covers 2 open-loop jacks, each with a dual-core LVDT; each actuator also has a selected output V.
R-LANE-ACTUATOR-UNITS.title: Slat and airbrake rows expand per actuator and per sensor core

R-LANE-AD-QUAD.source: Kala (ADE), JOAST 67(2A) 2015; Rajalakshmi et al., DSJ 56(1) 2006 https://www.publicationsdrdo.in/index.php/dsj/article/view/1863
R-LANE-AD-QUAD.statement: Each of the four ADCs has its own Ps/Pt/dP transducers and each vane has a quadruplex LVDT; lane n is read by ADC n and sent over RS-422 to DFCC channel n; lane V is the selected value relayed to the avionics bus.
R-LANE-AD-QUAD.title: Air-data transducers and vane LVDTs expand to four ADC lanes plus the selected output

R-LANE-FADEC-DUAL.source: parameter_inventory.csv redundancy column; f404_in20_engine_model.md Q3 (-400 dual NL pickups); NASA CR-191195
R-LANE-FADEC-DUAL.statement: Engine sensors the inventory marks dual (PLA, N1 dual pickups, N2 alternator winding per channel, T1, PS3, A8) are acquired by FADEC channels A and B; lane V is the validated value after FADEC signal validation (M08). The IN20 FADEC channel count is not public (dual is assumed in the inventory).
R-LANE-FADEC-DUAL.sweep: simplex (1 lane) or dual (2 lanes) per sensor
R-LANE-FADEC-DUAL.title: FADEC dual-channel acquisition (lanes A/B plus the validated output)

R-LANE-FCS-QUAD.source: Kala (ADE), JOAST 67(2A) 2015 https://joast.org/index.php/joast/article/view/317 (quadruplex, median voting); tejas_airframe_aero_fcs.md Q3
R-LANE-FCS-QUAD.statement: Rate sensors, accelerometers, pilot-command sensors and primary actuator position transducers are acquired by each of the four DFCC channels (lanes A-D, consumed by median voting); the voted/selected value (lane V) carries the row's bus mapping and sinks.
R-LANE-FCS-QUAD.title: DFCC quadruplex sensing expands to lanes A-D plus the voted output

R-LSB-BNR.source: parameter_inventory.csv recommended_quantization; data_pathway_and_formats.md Q2 Inferences; src/phalanx/dictionary/icd.py bnr_lsb
R-LSB-BNR.statement: Where the inventory gives no numeric quantisation (for example '16-bit BNR; choose LSB so steady-state sigma is ~0.3-1.5 LSB'), the LSB is the smallest power of two 2^k with which the full-scale range [rmin, rmax] fits an n-bit AS15532-style word (icd.bnr_lsb). Two's complement when rmin < 0: counts -2^(n-1) .. 2^(n-1) - 1, so LSB >= max(-rmin / 2^(n-1), max(rmax, 0) / (2^(n-1) - 1)) (the negative side holds one more count). Unsigned when rmin >= 0: counts 0 .. 2^n - 1, so LSB >= rmax / (2^n - 1). n = 16 for one 1553 word, 32 for a two-word (MSW-first) quantity, 12 for an FTI PCM word; on ARINC 429 the 19-bit BNR field (18 data bits + sign) gives LSB >= max(abs(rmin), abs(rmax)) / (2^18 - 1). The smallest word that fits the range at that LSB is then chosen. A value that leaves the aircraft only in a download or maintenance record (float64, no recorder word) keeps the LSB of the row's 16-bit word as its native (acquisition) step and has no recorder LSB.
R-LSB-BNR.sweep: LSB x0.25-x4; for two-word (32-bit) quantities from the 32-bit LSB up to the 16-bit (MSW-only) LSB, x1-x65536; re-choose so steady-state sigma/LSB is 0.3-1.5 once M13 noise is calibrated
R-LSB-BNR.title: Power-of-two BNR LSB computed from the full-scale range

R-LSB-DASHLINK.basis: TRANSFER: DASHlink Tail 687 recorder lattice [MEASURED on the proxy platform]
R-LSB-DASHLINK.statement: Where the inventory recommends a DASHlink-measured recorder lattice (for example 0.03125 % N1, 8 lb/h fuel flow, 0.044 deg AoA), that LSB is used for the Tejas bus/recorder word. The Tejas value is not public; DASHlink is a B757 QAR (other platform), so this is a stand-in, not a Tejas measurement. Native steps measured on DASHlink are NOT used in the Tejas dictionary (they are proxy-mode values).
R-LSB-DASHLINK.title: Recorder LSB transferred from the DASHlink recorder lattice

R-LSB-INVREC.statement: The inventory's recommended quantisation is used as the recorder LSB where it states no source.
R-LSB-INVREC.title: Recorder LSB as recommended by the inventory without a stated basis

R-LSB-MSDC.source: parameter_inventory.csv recommended_quantization; Henry, AGARD-CP-448 paper 37 Table 1 https://archive.org/details/DTIC_ADA203800
R-LSB-MSDC.statement: Where the inventory recommends the -400 MSDC resolution (16 rpm, 1 K, 0.5 psia, 0.06 psia), that LSB is used.
R-LSB-MSDC.sweep: LSB x0.25-x1 (FADEC likely finer than the legacy chain)
R-LSB-MSDC.title: Recorder LSB transferred from the F404-400 IECMS/MSDC chain

R-NATIVE-EQ-LSB.basis: native/recorder step ratios 1.0-1.6 measured on DASHlink (FF 1.0, N1 1.28, EGT 1.6) [MEASURED, proxy]
R-NATIVE-EQ-LSB.replacement: Tejas recorder data (residue analysis as in native_step_cal)
R-NATIVE-EQ-LSB.statement: Where the sensor/LRU native resolution is not public, native step = recorder LSB (a degenerate double quantiser). DASHlink native steps (N1/N2 0.04 %, EGT 0.8 degC, FF 8 lb/h) are proxy-mode values and are not used here.
R-NATIVE-EQ-LSB.title: Native step equal to the recorder LSB when not public

R-PER-RT.statement: AV.RT.STATUS (1553 status word), AV.LRU.BIT (mode code 19 BIT word) and AV.LRU.HEALTH (ADE-style 4-word health message: words 0-2 link/port/memory codes, word 3 device temperature 0.1 degF two's complement) are expanded to one channel set per remote terminal of the synthetic ICD.
R-PER-RT.title: RT status, BIT word and health message expanded per synthetic-ICD remote terminal

R-RANGE-FUEL-TOTAL.basis: internal 2,458 kg / 3,060 L and 1,200/800/725 L drop tanks [DIRECT, secondary]
R-RANGE-FUEL-TOTAL.source: parameter_inventory.csv FUEL.TOTAL range ('0-2,458 internal (+ drop tanks 1,200/800/725 L)'); tejas_utility_systems.md KQ3 (2,458 kg / 3,060 L; three-drop-tank ferry)
R-RANGE-FUEL-TOTAL.statement: FUEL.TOTAL full scale = 0 to internal fuel 2,458 kg (the inventory range) plus the largest stated drop-tank load, three tanks of 2 x 1,200 L + 800 L = 3,200 L (a three-drop-tank ferry is demonstrated), at the internal-fuel density 2,458 kg / 3,060 L = 0.803 kg/L (about 2,570 kg): about 5,030 kg, rounded up to 6,000 kg. The capacities are DIRECT (secondary); that one total word covers external fuel, and the rounding margin, are assumed.
R-RANGE-FUEL-TOTAL.sweep: full scale 5,030-8,000 kg (LSB 1 kg from the inventory; a 16-bit unsigned word holds up to 65,535 kg)
R-RANGE-FUEL-TOTAL.title: Total-fuel full scale from internal plus the largest external fuel load

R-RANGE-FULLSCALE.source: parameter_inventory.csv range column; tejas_utility_systems.md KQ5 (MIL-STD-704F transfer semantics)
R-RANGE-FULLSCALE.statement: Where the inventory gives an operating band rather than a measurement range, full scale = [0, 1.5 x band upper] for magnitudes (sources collapse to zero on transfer, MIL-STD-704F), and [-54 degC, band upper + 0.5 x (band upper + 54)] for temperatures (-54 degC is the inventory's common RTD floor); the band itself becomes a 'normal_band' limit.
R-RANGE-FULLSCALE.title: Full-scale range bracketing an inventory operating band

R-RANGE-NOTPUBLIC.source: parameter_inventory.csv (range '-' or not public); tejas_utility_systems.md KQ7 (26x8.0-14 tyre, chute <=340 km/h)
R-RANGE-NOTPUBLIC.statement: Where the inventory gives no range for the channel (range '-', 'not public', or only a range of another quantity: cabin dP for cabin absolute pressure, row-total internal fuel for each tank), a full scale is stated per channel (for example NWS +/-75 deg, OBOGS outlet 0-500 kPa, strain +/-5000 microstrain, wheel speed 0-3500 rpm from the 340 km/h emergency chute speed and the 26 in main tyre); each value is an ASSUMPTION swept inside the stated range. A full scale derived from capacities the inventory does give has its own rule (R-RANGE-FUEL-TOTAL).
R-RANGE-NOTPUBLIC.sweep: per channel, x0.5-x2 of full scale
R-RANGE-NOTPUBLIC.title: Full-scale range not public

R-RANGE-SENSOR.statement: A voted output can take any value its lanes can, so its word range is the sensor range (FCS.VOTED.NZ uses the ASA +/-13 g range; the inventory's -3.5..+9 g is the operating envelope and becomes a limit).
R-RANGE-SENSOR.title: Voted outputs inherit the sensor range

R-RATE-AV.basis: DIRECT-unnamed: ADE 12.5 Hz health message with 4 minor frames (JOAST 63(4) 598)
R-RATE-AV.statement: 50 Hz minor frame, 12.5 Hz major frame (4 minor frames), 25 and 6.25 Hz binary sub-multiples.
R-RATE-AV.title: Avionics 1553 rate groups

R-RATE-CDR.basis: DASHlink measured 0.25-16 Hz [MEASURED proxy]; 14 CFR App. M minima
R-RATE-CDR.title: Crash-recorder rates

R-RATE-ECMS.source: Muir et al., AGARD-CP-448 paper 7 https://archive.org/details/DTIC_ADA203800 ; tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q4 (IECMS recording rates)
R-RATE-ECMS.statement: ECMS gas path 10 Hz (altitude, Mach, AoA, T0, T1, N1, N2, T56, P56, PS3, Wfm, PLA, A8), slow 1 Hz (Nz, oil pressure, vibration, fuel temperature, anti-ice valve, bleed door), event windows 5 s pre + 25-35 s post, take-off record 6-10 s.
R-RATE-ECMS.title: ECMS record groups

R-RATE-EVT.statement: EVT (on change), SORTIE (per sortie) and INSP (per inspection) are aperiodic.
R-RATE-EVT.title: Aperiodic groups

R-RATE-FADEC.statement: The FADEC acquisition frame is 60 Hz, inside the 50-67 Hz TRANSFER band (NASA FADEC templates); 60 Hz divides the 240 Hz truth step exactly (240 = 4 x 60).
R-RATE-FADEC.title: FADEC frame 60 Hz inside the 50-67 Hz band

R-RATE-FCS.basis: 80 Hz DIRECT; sub-rates TRANSFER: F/A-18 FCC (NASA TM-107601)
R-RATE-FCS.statement: DFCC frame 80 Hz (12.5 ms); sub-rates 40/20/10 Hz.
R-RATE-FCS.title: DFCC 80 Hz frame and binary sub-rates

R-RATE-FTI.basis: TRANSFER: HAL trainer FTI 64 Hz; HARV 25-800 sps
R-RATE-FTI.statement: FTI channels at a nominal 64 Hz (band 64-800 Hz).
R-RATE-FTI.title: FTI nominal rate

R-RATE-HF.statement: Raw accelerometer data are acquired at a nominal 10 kHz (band 2.5-10 kHz) and reduced to 1 Hz features.
R-RATE-HF.title: Raw vibration acquisition rate

R-RATE-HUMS.basis: TRANSFER anchor: IECMS 1 Hz slow channels
R-RATE-HUMS.statement: The HUMS DAU records utility analogs at a nominal 1 Hz (configurable band 1-10 Hz).
R-RATE-HUMS.title: HUMS DAU nominal rate

R-RATE-LRU.statement: Nominal internal frames: INS 100 Hz (band 100-2000), hydraulic model 200 Hz (band 200-500), slow utility 10 Hz (band 1-10), utility EUs and CWS 40 Hz (HARV utility data at 40 sps), radar altimeter 25 Hz, AHRS 100 Hz, SMS and radar 50 Hz.
R-RATE-LRU.title: LRU-internal acquisition frames

R-RATE-SLOW.statement: SLOW1 is 1 Hz (time, LSS, battery, vibration features).
R-RATE-SLOW.tag: TRANSFER: IECMS 1 Hz group; DASHlink 1 Hz class
R-RATE-SLOW.title: 1 Hz bus/recorder group

R-REC-CDR48.source: tejas_avionics_and_parameter_inventory.md Q7 (attitudes and rates at 8; air data and engine at 4)
R-REC-CDR48.statement: Inventory 'CDR4-8' rows record attitudes, heading and body rates/accelerations at CDR8 and positions, velocities and status at CDR4.
R-REC-CDR48.title: CDR 4-8 Hz split

R-REC-DEFAULT.source: parameter_inventory.csv sink flags and rate_group_record; tables/sinks.yaml
R-REC-DEFAULT.statement: A sink the inventory flags (Y/A) but for which the row names no record group gets the sink default: COCKPIT -> DISPLAY, MPDRU -> LOG (on change + per-flight log), CDR -> CDR1, ECMS_HUMS -> ECMS1 (engine rows) or HUMS, FTI -> FTI.
R-REC-DEFAULT.sweep: per sink, any record group of that sink
R-REC-DEFAULT.title: Default record group for a flagged sink with no record token

R-REC-SETUP.basis: event/index semantics TRANSFER: IRIG 106-15 Ch10 10.6.7 and Ch9 Table 9-3
R-REC-SETUP.statement: The SYNTHETIC recorder (R-1) records event and index packets: three recorder events (REC_START, TIME_LOCK_LOST, TIME_LOCK_REGAINED; type R, priority 1, no initial capture, limit count 65,535) and a time-based index every 10 s, as M16 writes them (IRIG 106-15 10.6.7.3: index packets are enabled when event packets are; TMATS Table 9-3 R-x\EV, R-x\IDX). The TMATS generator emits these attributes from the dictionary.
R-REC-SETUP.sweep: index interval 1-60 s (no Tejas recorder setup is public)
R-REC-SETUP.title: Recorder setup - recording events and time-based index

R-SINK-ASSUMED.source: parameter_inventory.csv sink_* columns (Y evidenced, A assumed)
R-SINK-ASSUMED.statement: Sink membership flagged 'A' (assumed) in the inventory is carried with basis 'assumed'.
R-SINK-ASSUMED.title: Sinks the inventory marks as assumed ('A')

R-SINK-FIX.source: parameter_inventory.csv bus/rate_group_record columns; architecture M08 (N2 scheduled on PLA/T25)
R-SINK-FIX.statement: ENG.T25 is consumed inside the FADEC (N2c schedule on T25); SYS.PHASE and USAGE.TAC are computed on the ground; STRUCT.STRAIN and FTI.ALL are FTI (their fti_only flag is N although their bus/record groups are FTI-only - an inventory inconsistency). (MX.* rows need no fix: their record column names the maintenance record.)
R-SINK-FIX.title: Consumers for rows the inventory gives no sink

R-SINK-INTERNAL.basis: DFCC median voting DIRECT (Kala); FADEC cross-channel checks TRANSFER (report §9)
R-SINK-INTERNAL.statement: Sensor lanes are consumed inside the acquiring LRU (DFCC median voting; FADEC cross-channel validation); harness averages are consumed by the FADEC T5 average; they reach recorders only through the validated output.
R-SINK-INTERNAL.title: Lanes are consumed by the voter or signal validator

R-T5-HARNESS.statement: The 8 T5 probes are electrically averaged within 2 harnesses (open probe drops out, shorted probe pulls the harness low); the acquired quantities are the two harness averages and their FADEC average.
R-T5-HARNESS.title: T5 probes are averaged inside two harnesses; no per-probe channels

R-TIME-RTC.source: IRIG 106 Ch10 (10 MHz 48-bit RTC), data_pathway_and_formats.md Q4; architecture AD-35
R-TIME-RTC.statement: The recorder real-time counter runs at 10 MHz (100 ns ticks); all times are int64 nanoseconds (AD-35).
R-TIME-RTC.title: Recorder RTC resolution

R-UNIT-CHOICE.statement: Where the inventory lists alternative units, the reported unit follows the cited bus word or recorder practice: %N1/%N2 (DASHlink, F/A-18C SDC), nozzle position % (F/A-18C SDC), pilot commands %, load factor in standard gravity (range and LSB stated in g), level in %.
R-UNIT-CHOICE.sweep: alternative unit (no physical effect; conversion is exact or linear)
R-UNIT-CHOICE.title: Reported engineering unit chosen among the inventory's alternatives

R-UNITS-ASSUMED.statement: Brake pressure is expanded to the two main wheels (L/R), the main AC generator voltage to three phases (115/200 V 3-phase 400 Hz feed of the HAL TRUs), and drop-tank contents to three stations (inboard L/R, centreline).
R-UNITS-ASSUMED.sweep: unit count +/-1 (e.g. single-phase sensing, nose-wheel brake absent/present)
R-UNITS-ASSUMED.title: Per-unit expansion whose unit list is not public

R-UNITS-INV.source: parameter_inventory.csv row text; tejas_utility_systems.md KQ3 (tanks, drop tanks 2 x 1,200 L inboard + centreline), KQ5
R-UNITS-INV.statement: Rows that name their units (fuel tanks F1/F1A/F2/wing L/R and drop-tank stations; DC buses main/essential/ emergency; TRU 1/2; DFCC channels; ADC units; generator phases; gears; 1553 buses) expand to one channel per unit.
R-UNITS-INV.title: Per-unit expansion named in the inventory row

R-VALIDITY.statement: ARINC-429 SSM (BNR and discrete tables) and MIL-STD-1553B status-word semantics map to the contract validity names (NORMAL, NO_COMPUTED_DATA, FUNCTIONAL_TEST, FAILURE_WARNING, BUS_INVALID). Contract precedence (AD-38/41, AD-45): a set 1553 validity-word bit or RT status error is BUS_INVALID; FAILURE_WARNING comes only from the ARINC-429 SSM failure-warning code.
R-VALIDITY.title: Validity semantics

R-VOTED-SEPARATE.statement: FCS.RSA.Q and FCS.ASA.NZ have no V lane because the inventory carries FCS.VOTED.Q and FCS.VOTED.NZ.
R-VOTED-SEPARATE.title: No V lane where the inventory has a separate voted row

title: Phalanx virtual Tejas-class fleet: HAL Tejas Mk1A-class airframe, F404-GE-IN20 composite engine
